goal: Add a low-risk LIQUID_DEPTH auction-buying route for the current AuxVmangos live authority: nominate only stackable deep discounts, require a fresh exact named full-depth recheck, then buy only at <=60% of confirmed depth with conservative resale/cut/ROI and strict 10g listing, 20g item and 50g session commitment caps.
notes: User has about 1000g and requested a new low-risk buying algorithm after Vendor/DE became the only gameplay-confirmed routes. LIQUID_DEPTH does not rely on historical pricing. Discovery data is nomination-only; before any PlaceAuctionBid it performs an exact named query over all result pages, requires at least 20 higher-priced reference units from at least 3 sellers, entry <=60% of the exact depth unit, assumes only 90% of that depth price for resale, subtracts 5% AH cut, requires >=1g expected profit and >=25% ROI, and rechecks the exact listing on its page. Capital is fail-closed at 10g/listing, 20g/item/session and 50g/route-session, with existing global wallet/session caps also honored. The route uses its own pending/unknown money-delta confirmation and blocks LOOP during exact verification/transaction. Vendor/DE code is untouched. Because this is a new TOC-loaded Lua module rather than a hot-bundle monkeypatch, one /reload is required after ECONOMY installation before first gameplay test. No gameplay success is claimed before user test.
